decisions.reason: The online customer portal is distant from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, but it supports the planned deeper brand collaboration and costs little to maintain, so slack allows the firm to carry it while its results remain uncertain.

The packaging display solution builds on established competencies but is only mentioned rather than featured, so its results against aspirations are unclear; it is cheap to carry within the core display business, so the firm keeps it for now.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is close to the core business and has its own page, which signals commitment, and it fits the firm's display-only focus at low incremental cost.
The small counter display is a standard, close-to-core product with its own page, so it likely meets aspirations, and dropping it would free few resources.
The large freestanding information display matches the broader 3D cardboard strategy and has a dedicated page, so the firm has no performance-shortfall trigger to drop it.
